Package org.springframework.beans

@NullMarked package org.springframework.beans
This package contains interfaces and classes for manipulating Java beans. It is used by most other Spring packages.

BeanWrapper 对象可用于设置和获取单个或批量 Bean 属性。

本包中的类在 Rod Johnson 所著的《Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development》（Wrox, 2002）第 11 章中进行了讨论。 Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development
